summary: Reviewed seasonal field integration, Easter page wiring, SSOT structure, and the included consumers. The main risk is annual occasion data is split between the new resolver contract and page-local constants or buttons, so future yearly/API updates can drift. SSOT reads and empty-state rendering look sound in the provided pack.
appears_sound: Blank seasonal fields are normalised and dropped in lib/seasonal-utils.ts:230, which keeps empty values out of UI rows.
SeasonalDynamicDetails returns null when there are no resolved rows at components/seasonal/SeasonalDynamicDetails.tsx:36, so no empty card is rendered.
The included SSOT consumers still read stable keys: HeroBadge reads ratings.google at components/HeroBadge.tsx:7 and menu-page-data reads food correction data at lib/menu-page-data.ts:30.

findings.description: The Easter page has two owners for annual occasion data: the dynamic field object is documented as the refresh point, but JSON-LD dates and service times come from separate page constants. A yearly update could change the rendered details while leaving structured data stale, or the reverse.
findings.evidence: EASTER_SUNDAY_DYNAMIC is empty at app/easter-sunday/page.tsx:35, while EASTER_SUNDAY_DATE feeds startDate/endDate at app/easter-sunday/page.tsx:100.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: If the 2027 Event schema is intentionally one-off and outside the A11 dynamic contract, the split may be acceptable.
findings.what_would_confirm: Confirm whether annual event dates and service windows must be supplied through SeasonalDynamicFields or page-local constants.

findings.description: The resolver exposes ctaLabel and ctaDestination, but the only shown resolver consumer ignores them and the Easter buttons remain static. This makes CTA overrides look supported by the shared contract while having no visible effect in the shown page flow.
findings.evidence: resolveSeasonalFields returns ctaLabel/ctaDestination at lib/seasonal-utils.ts:266, but SeasonalDynamicDetails only uses hasDetails/details at components/seasonal/SeasonalDynamicDetails.tsx:34.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: CTA overrides may be intended for a separate page-level consumer not included in this pack.
findings.what_would_confirm: Check whether seasonal page templates are expected to read resolved ctaLabel and ctaDestination outside SeasonalDynamicDetails.

empty_categories: No client/server boundary leak found in the changed seasonal code.
No database or raw data-access boundary issue found in the pack.
No removed SSOT key reads found in the provided HeroBadge and menu-page-data snippets.
No seasonal partial-field rendering gap found for normal detail rows.
